Nuclear Chemistry: Radioactivity of Nucleus, Definition, types, effect ad properties of radioactive elements. Nuclear stability, Mass defects, Nuclear binding energy. Energy released in radiation. Electromotive Forces: Electrochemical Cell, Cell Reaction, Cell Potential, Cell Representation, Measurement of EMF of a Cell, Relation Between EMF and Free Energy, Electrode Potential, Electrochemical Series, Nernest's Equation, Different Types of Reference Electrodes and pH Measurement, Over Potential, Lithium Ion Battery, Fuel Cell its latest development. The distribution table lists ICT 2105/2106 for Data Communication, while the detailed section labels the same subject ICT 2107/2108. The portal preserves the distribution-table codes and displays the discrepancy in source notes.
The source lists Option-I/II/III as placeholders in semester tables; actual choices are listed separately.

The detailed description for ICT 4220 Strategic Management Sessional states “Sessional based on ICT 4217”; the portal uses the generic related-sessional description in its course page and preserves this source discrepancy here.
